page1.title: This alarm refuses to stop.
page1.copy: No snooze abuse. No half-asleep dismissals. DawnVow only shuts up when you prove you’re awake.

page2.title: Prove you’re awake.
page2.copy: Answer quiz questions or get out of bed and photograph a specific object. That’s the deal.

page3.title: We need a few permissions.
page3.copy: Exact alarms to fire on time, notifications to show the ring screen, camera for photo missions. We’ll ask only when needed.

demo.question: When does DawnVow stop ringing?
demo.wrongOption: When I tap snooze ten times
